title: Exponential BFS machine state
statement: A machine state is a tuple of 18 natural numbers $(N,L_g,s,s_1,X,w,K,B_s,U,V,T,T_2,Z,C,ch,c,c_1)$, representing respectively the input-length counter, logarithm bound, radius, next radius, width factor, code width, code bound, memory-region base, source code, target code, outward-walk counter, return-walk counter, copy-and-shift scratch register, shift counter, relaxation-round change flag, marked-code count, and first-search count.
